title: useRootData
summary: Read the application root loader’s data.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Takes no runtime arguments. Pass the root loader function type to derive its return data, or an explicit data type. Requires RouterApplication or the application mounting helpers; RouterProvider alone does not create root data.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Returns the current application root value as RouteData<T>. The hook does not fetch or invoke the loader. It updates when the root data store publishes a new value.

sections.title: Example
sections.body: Use a type-only import so the server loader implementation stays out of the browser module.

sections.title: Targeted revalidation
sections.body: useRouteLoaderData("root") reads the same root value. To refresh it, call the function returned by useRevalidator with { route: "root" }. The application must have registered a root loader callback; naming a target does not create a loader or transport endpoint.
